इन् इन्, cl. 8. P., Ved. इनोति, ऐनोत्, 2nd
sing. impv. इनुहि or इनु, cl. 9. P., 1st pl.
इनीमसि, cl. 6. P. (fr. इन्व्) इन्वति, perf. 3rd pl.
इन्विरे, to advance upon, press upon, drive; to infuse
strength, invigorate; to use force, to force; drive away,
keep back, remove; to have in one's power, to take
possession of, pervade; dispose; to be lord or master
of a thing or an art. See इन्व्.
